method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Spam Control Act 2007 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation in force from 1 April 2022, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/SCA2007.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under the standing grant in SSO's Terms of Use cl.13 - see ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run spam-cases.l4 ; l4 run spam-civil-action-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 2 to 15 and both Schedules - the whole Act bar s 1 (short title), s 16 (codes of practice), s 17 (amendment of Schedules) and s 18 (regulations). spam-act.l4 carries the definitions (commercial, electronic, unsolicited, in bulk, Singapore link), the First Schedule exclusion, the s 9 prohibition on dictionary attacks and address harvesting, and the Second Schedule requirements that s 11 imports. spam-civil-action.l4 carries Part 4: the s 12 secondary prohibitions and carriers' safe harbour, the s 13 right of action, the s 14 relief and the two caps on statutory damages, and s 15 costs. The conclusion that a message's primary purpose is one of the twelve in s 3(1) is a judgment on the whole message and is a fact supplied. No regulations or orders under s 6(2) or s 17 were retrieved; the s 6(1) thresholds are carried as parameters for that reason.
